item.title: Collegeville/Perkiomen Trail — Sun Nov 29, 10:00 AM
item.description:
Walking Tails Parking: Don't park in the TD Bank parking lot. Instead, park between the TD Bank and the LabCorp building.
CLICK DIRECTLY ON THE MAP IF YOU THINK YOU ARE LOST. IT WILL BRING YOU RIGHT TO US WHERE WE MEET.
We will meet in the parking lot then head south on the Perkiomen Trail for 1.5 to 2 miles turning around to head back the way we came when the group wishes, for a total of 3 to 4 miles. The trail is about 10-12 feet wide and graveled with tree cover providing shade.
Start Time: We will start hiking promptly at the scheduled time.
Duration of the walk – depends on the people and dogs in the group. We frequently end up walking in smaller packs based on the comfort level of the participants.
Please remember pooh bags and that your dog must be on a leash. Sturdy shoes or hiking boots are recommended. Dress appropriately for weather conditions.

item.title: Wednesday Late Mornings Brunch Rides Casual Pace Variable Distance — Wed Dec 16, 11:00 AM
item.description: Lancaster Bicycle Club (LBC) Meetup As the mornings grow colder it is time to ride later in the mornings Every Wednesday late morning...Ride and eat Yummy brunch together. Please do not go on this ride unless you will ride at a casual pace and stay with the group . We will meet to ride to brunch at a casual pace. After eating some may split up with some returning to the start and others going longer and faster. Helmets are mandatory; No ear buds or audible music playing devices. Please bring water, and a basic repair kit (spare tube, tire levers, pump/CO2 inflator). To eliminate passing around a pen and paper waiver, we encourage LBC Club membership and Meetup RSVP below to join this ride. RSVP also allows us to contact you after the ride if needed. If you do not RSVP you are not covered by the club excess accident insurance policy; only club members who RSVP are covered. Being on Meetup does not mean you are a club member. Join here- https://www.lancasterbikeclub.net/content.aspx?page
